tasks.gr12-development-of-the-self-in-society-: Topic: Development of the Self in Society. Cover personal mission statements, realistic goal-setting, self-motivation, resilience, responsibility, and the effect of habits, attitudes and support systems on Grade 12 success. Ask learners to evaluate final-year choices, improve a goal or mission statement, identify support strategies, or reflect on how responsibility and discipline shape achievement.
tasks.gr12-healthy-relationships-and-wellbeing: Topic: Healthy Relationships and Wellbeing. Cover respectful relationships, reproductive health knowledge, informed decision-making, coping with stress and conflict, and the role of support networks. Ask learners to evaluate relationship scenarios, separate myths from facts, identify healthy coping responses, or explain how support systems protect wellbeing.
tasks.gr12-study-planning-for-exit-level-readi: Topic: Study Planning for Exit Level Readiness. Cover revision planning, time management, exam discipline, help-seeking, accountability and support before major assessments. Ask learners to build a realistic study timetable, evaluate exam-preparation habits, choose effective revision strategies, or explain how accountability and help-seeking improve readiness.
tasks.gr12-physical-education-task-1-t1: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 1. Cover fitness maintenance, conditioning principles, balanced routines, participation, safety, and the role of physical activity in managing academic pressure. Ask learners to describe fitness components, evaluate safe participation habits, reflect on balance between exercise and study, or set realistic activity goals.
